This is from your chat box and my answers.

Found it. The NerdQaxe++ shows delivered Aug 14, so the upgrade against your RMA is the team's once the unit reaches the warehouse. Separately, the Bitaxe Supra Hex 703 on that order still hasn't shipped and I have no date for it. Sorry about that.

We, worked out something on the Supra Hex 703, not worried about that

I can swap that line now for more TH and you pay the difference: NerdQX, 8 TH/s, $299.99, or the GekkoScience KBOX, 22 TH/s, $800.

My flag to a manager didn't go through, so please also email (email hidden) with the order number. Want either swap?

As for a new miner, I would prefer something with ethernet.

Please advise.
Thank you

Raland

Hi Raland,

Good catch on ethernet, that rules the NerdQX out, it's WiFi only. Scratch that one.

Wired options: the Magic Miner 40T, $799, 40 TH/s, RJ45 plus dual-band WiFi, ships November 14. The Harlo B30, $899, 30 TH/s, ethernet, ships October 30. The K. at $800 also has ethernet, but only 22 TH/s, so the 40T beats it on price and hashrate both.

My pick is the 40T. Say the word and I'll get it set up for you.

Nothing for you to send anywhere. The R. upgrade is with a colleague and they'll confirm it with you directly today.

Sarah, HeliumDeploy
